description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a small, senior engineering team building data and agent infrastructure that helps AI systems interpret industrial plant data. You will own features from backend services through operator-facing interfaces, working with customers to turn real operational needs into platform improvements.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and scale backend services and data layers using Go, TypeScript, Postgres, and Neo4j.

 - Develop parsers and integrations that bring SCADA, PLC, historian, MES, and ERP data into a unified plant model.

 - Build agent infrastructure and large-scale data ingestion pipelines across AWS and Azure.

 - Design clear, practical interfaces for industrial operators.

 - Own features end to end, incorporating customer feedback into product improvements.

 - Work directly with customers in defense, oil and gas, and agribusiness to validate solutions.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years of full-stack or backend engineering experience shipping production systems.

 - Experience delivering backend systems and LLM-powered products in production.

 - Proficiency with Go, TypeScript, Postgres, or Neo4j, and experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.

 - Experience building industrial data parsers and integrations, agent infrastructure, or large-scale ingestion pipelines.

 - Familiarity with graph databases or retrieval-augmented generation over structured data.

 - AI coding tools such as Cursor or Claude Code are a core part of your development workflow.

 - Strong computer science fundamentals, demonstrated through a degree or equivalent experience.

 - Interest in working directly with industrial customers and designing interfaces for operational environments.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Salary range: $180,000 to $350,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

On-site in New York, New York.
